description: Defines the configurable questions, response types, validation rules, evidence requirements, and blocking behavior used by the Data4Mat Takeover Audit module.

questions.text: What is the client's legal name?
questions.helpText: Use the registered legal name of the client organization.

questions.text: Who is the primary client contact?
questions.helpText: Record the main person responsible for communication and approvals.

questions.text: Which websites, domains, or digital services are included in the engagement?
questions.helpText: Record every website, domain, application, or related service included in the takeover audit.

collection.emptyMessage: No systems have been added to the engagement scope.

questions.text: What is the agreed engagement start date?
What type of engagement has been agreed?
What is the current commercial status of the engagement?
Is access review included in the agreed scope?
Is backup verification included in the agreed scope?
Is DNS inventory and control verification included in the agreed scope?
Is hosting review included in the agreed scope?
Is application review included in the agreed scope?
Is security review included in the agreed scope?
Is performance review included in the agreed scope?
Is compliance review included in the agreed scope?
Is remediation planning included in the agreed scope?
Record all items explicitly excluded from the agreed scope.

collection.emptyMessage: No scope exclusions have been recorded.

questions.text: Record commercial risks, dependencies, or assumptions that may affect the engagement.

collection.emptyMessage: No commercial risks or dependencies have been recorded.

questions.text: Record all systems and services for which access is required.
questions.helpText: Include registrars, DNS providers, hosting systems, applications, email platforms, analytics services, payment services, and other relevant systems.

collection.emptyMessage: No required systems have been recorded.

questions.text: Were credentials transferred without using plain email?
questions.helpText: Credentials must be transferred through an approved secure method.

questions.text: Has a unique account been created for Data4Mat where separate access is supported?
Is MFA enabled for all identified admin-level accounts?
Have all shared administrative accounts been identified?
Have all unknown or unexplained administrative users been identified?
Record known user accounts and their assigned roles.

collection.emptyMessage: No user accounts have been recorded.

questions.text: Record missing access and other access-related blockers.

collection.emptyMessage: No access blockers have been recorded.

questions.text: Is all critical access documented and confirmed sufficiently to continue the takeover audit?
questions.helpText: Select No or Requires confirmation if any critical access remains unclear.

blockingRules.message: Critical access is not sufficiently documented and confirmed. Dependent takeover work cannot continue.

questions.text: Record all backup systems and backup methods currently used for the systems in scope.
questions.helpText: Include hosting backups, application backups, database backups, file backups, external storage, and third-party backup services.

collection.emptyMessage: No backup systems have been recorded.

questions.text: Does the available backup include all files required to restore the systems in scope?
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference the backup contents, manifest, archive listing, or other evidence showing what is included.

questions.text: Does the available backup include all databases required to restore the systems in scope?
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference the database export, backup archive, provider confirmation, or other evidence.

questions.text: Are backups stored separately from the production environment?
questions.helpText: A failure or compromise of the production environment should not automatically destroy every usable backup.

questions.text: Are backup operations automated where automation is available?
Are backup failures monitored and reported to a responsible person?
Is access to backup storage restricted to authorized users?
Are sensitive backups encrypted where encryption is required or reasonably available?
What is the declared restore verification status?
questions.helpText: A backup existing is not the same as confirming that it can be restored.

choices.label: Archive inspected but restore not tested

questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference the restore test record, test environment, logs, screenshots, or inspection evidence.

questions.text: When was the most recent restore test performed?
Record the restore test result and any limitations discovered.
Has Data4Mat created or secured a current pre-intervention backup before any production changes are made?

choices.label: Not applicable because no intervention is authorized

questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference the backup created or secured for the takeover and its storage location.

questions.text: Record backup-related deficiencies, unresolved risks, or required actions.

collection.emptyMessage: No backup issues have been recorded.

questions.text: Is a sufficiently current and usable backup verified so the takeover audit can continue?
questions.helpText: Select No or Requires confirmation when the backup is missing, failed, incomplete, inaccessible, or insufficiently verified.
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference the verified backup and the evidence supporting the declared restore status.

blockingRules.message: A sufficiently current and usable backup has not been verified. Dependent takeover work cannot continue.

questions.text: Who is the domain registrar?
questions.helpText: Record the registrar currently responsible for the primary domain.
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference registrar account information, an invoice, WHOIS/RDAP information, or written client confirmation.

questions.text: Record the authoritative nameservers for the domain.
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference the authoritative nameserver lookup or registrar configuration.

collection.emptyMessage: No authoritative nameservers have been recorded.

questions.text: Who provides authoritative DNS hosting for the domain?
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference the DNS provider account, nameserver configuration, or other supporting evidence.

questions.text: Who owns or controls the administrative DNS account?
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference account ownership, access records, invoices, or written confirmation.

questions.text: Does Data4Mat have sufficient administrative access to review the DNS configuration?
Is a current DNS zone export available?
Record the current DNS records.
questions.helpText: Record all active and relevant records, including records whose purpose is currently unknown.
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference a zone export, provider screenshot, DNS lookup, or other record inventory.

collection.emptyMessage: No DNS records have been recorded.

questions.text: Record the email-related DNS checks.
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference DNS lookups, mail-provider configuration, validation tools, or screenshots.

collection.emptyMessage: No email DNS checks have been recorded.

questions.text: Record DNS-related risks, unidentified records, and recommended actions.

collection.emptyMessage: No DNS risks have been recorded.

questions.text: Is DNS ownership and administrative control sufficiently documented and confirmed?
questions.helpText: Select No or Requires confirmation if the responsible DNS account, provider, or authorized controller remains unclear.
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference the account, provider, ownership, access, or written confirmation supporting the conclusion.

blockingRules.message: DNS ownership or administrative control is not sufficiently confirmed. DNS changes must not be made.

questions.text: Who provides the hosting environment?
questions.helpText: Record the company or service currently hosting the systems in scope.
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference the hosting account, invoice, control panel, server information, or written client confirmation.

questions.text: Who owns or controls the hosting account?
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference account details, billing records, access records, contracts, or written confirmation.

questions.text: What type of hosting environment is used?
Which hosting management interface is available?
Does Data4Mat have sufficient administrative access to review the hosting environment?
Record the technical hosting environment details.
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference the hosting panel, server information, runtime configuration, or provider documentation.

collection.emptyMessage: No hosting environment details have been recorded.

questions.text: Record the available hosting features and operational capabilities.

collection.emptyMessage: No hosting features have been recorded.

questions.text: Record the hosting resource limits and current usage.
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference hosting quotas, provider dashboards, server reports, or monitoring information.

collection.emptyMessage: No hosting resource limits have been recorded.

questions.text: Record the SSL and HTTPS checks.
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference certificate information, browser checks, redirect tests, provider settings, or scan results.

collection.emptyMessage: No SSL or HTTPS checks have been recorded.

questions.text: Record hosting-related risks and recommended actions.

collection.emptyMessage: No hosting risks have been recorded.

questions.text: Is the hosting environment sufficiently documented and accessible for the takeover audit to continue?
questions.helpText: Select No or Requires confirmation when ownership, access, environment details, or critical operational limits remain unclear.

questions.text: Record the primary application platform and technical foundation.
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference the administration interface, source files, package manifests, runtime information, repository, or other technical evidence.

collection.emptyMessage: No application platform details have been recorded.

questions.text: Record installed plugins, extensions, packages, and application dependencies.
questions.helpText: Include active, inactive, required, custom, licensed, and externally maintained components.
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference administration exports, package manifests, dependency files, screenshots, licenses, or repository information.

collection.emptyMessage: No plugins, extensions, or dependencies have been recorded.

questions.text: Record external integrations and connected services.
questions.helpText: Include forms, email delivery, analytics, payments, authentication, APIs, CRM systems, storage services, and external automation.

collection.emptyMessage: No external integrations have been recorded.

questions.text: Record observations about application content and structure.

collection.emptyMessage: No content or structure observations have been recorded.

questions.text: Is the application source, configuration, and deployment process sufficiently documented to be maintainable and transferable?
Can the application be maintained without unnecessary dependence on undocumented proprietary knowledge or inaccessible third-party accounts?
Record application risks and recommended actions.

collection.emptyMessage: No application risks have been recorded.

questions.text: Is the application sufficiently understood and documented for the takeover audit to continue?
questions.helpText: Select No or Requires confirmation when the platform, dependencies, integrations, source, or critical custom code remain materially unclear.

questions.text: Record the security baseline controls for administrative access.
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference account settings, access records, screenshots, authentication policies, or written confirmation.

collection.emptyMessage: No administrative security controls have been recorded.

choices.label: Credentials not sent by plain email

questions.text: Record the application and website security checks.
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference administration screens, configuration files, scan results, source files, provider settings, or screenshots.

collection.emptyMessage: No application security checks have been recorded.

choices.label: Security plugin, firewall, or WAF present
Application file editing restricted where applicable
Admin URL and user enumeration risks reviewed
Default or unused administrative accounts removed

questions.text: Record externally exposed services, files, systems, and environments.
questions.helpText: Include open ports, public administration interfaces, exposed sensitive files, forgotten staging sites, development systems, and search-index exposure.
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference scan results, DNS records, browser checks, server configuration, screenshots, or search-engine results.

collection.emptyMessage: No external exposure checks have been recorded.

questions.text: Has the application been checked for indicators of compromise or malicious modification?
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference malware scans, file-integrity checks, log reviews, provider reports, or manual inspection records.

questions.text: Have application, server, authentication, and security logs been reviewed where available?
Are security alerts and significant authentication events delivered to a responsible person?
Record all security findings requiring action.

collection.emptyMessage: No security findings have been recorded.

questions.text: Are there any unresolved critical security findings?
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference the relevant security findings, containment evidence, or incident records.

questions.text: Record any formal acceptance of unresolved security risk.
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference written client acceptance, approval correspondence, signed documentation, or another durable approval record.

collection.emptyMessage: No security risks have been formally accepted.

questions.text: Is the security posture sufficiently documented and controlled for the takeover audit to continue?
questions.helpText: Select No or Requires confirmation when critical exposure, compromised systems, uncontrolled administrative access, or other material security risks remain unresolved.

choices.label: Yes, with documented and controlled risks

questions.text: Record the performance test context.
questions.helpText: Record the conditions under which the baseline was measured so later tests can be compared fairly.
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference performance reports, exported test results, screenshots, or saved URLs.

collection.emptyMessage: No performance test context has been recorded.

questions.text: Record the measured performance baseline.
questions.helpText: Record observed values only. Do not estimate missing metrics.
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference the corresponding performance test report or screenshot.

collection.emptyMessage: No performance metrics have been recorded.

questions.text: Record observed performance bottlenecks.

collection.emptyMessage: No performance bottlenecks have been recorded.

questions.text: Record possible performance improvements.
questions.helpText: Do not promise a specific improvement without implementation and retesting.

collection.emptyMessage: No performance improvements have been proposed.

questions.text: Is the recorded performance baseline sufficiently complete and reproducible?
questions.helpText: The test context, tested URLs, tools, cache state, and measured values should be documented sufficiently for later comparison.

questions.text: Is the current performance condition sufficiently documented for the takeover audit to continue?
Record which compliance-related areas are relevant to the systems in scope.
questions.helpText: This is an operational assessment only. It does not replace legal review.

collection.emptyMessage: No compliance areas have been recorded.

questions.text: Record observed personal data collection and processing.
questions.helpText: Record visible and confirmed processing only. Mark uncertain purposes or destinations as requiring confirmation.
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference forms, privacy notices, application settings, service configurations, database records, or screenshots.

collection.emptyMessage: No personal data collection has been recorded.

questions.text: Record visible policy, consent, and transparency checks.
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference public pages, forms, consent interfaces, screenshots, or observed tracking behavior.

collection.emptyMessage: No visible compliance checks have been recorded.

choices.label: Forms explain what happens after submission
Marketing consent is clear and separate
Accessibility information is visible where applicable

questions.text: Record cookies, trackers, analytics tools, and other client-side data collection.
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference browser storage, network requests, consent-platform scans, source code, tag managers, or screenshots.

collection.emptyMessage: No tracking technologies have been recorded.

questions.text: Record compliance-related findings requiring client, specialist, or legal confirmation.
questions.helpText: Describe factual observations and required confirmation. Do not present legal conclusions.

collection.emptyMessage: No compliance findings have been recorded.

questions.text: Have all visible compliance concerns been recorded without presenting the audit as legal advice?
Is the compliance review sufficiently documented for the takeover audit to continue?
questions.helpText: Select Yes with risks when unresolved matters are recorded for client or specialist confirmation.

choices.label: Yes, with documented matters requiring confirmation

questions.text: Record every issue identified during the takeover audit.
questions.helpText: Every issue must have an area, severity, status, owner, and clear next action. Do not leave unresolved observations outside the issue register.

collection.emptyMessage: No takeover audit issues have been recorded.

fields.label: Issue reference
fields.helpText: Use the assigned issue reference, such as TA-001.

questions.text: Record additional information for blocked issues.

collection.emptyMessage: No blocked issues have been recorded.

questions.text: Record resolution evidence for resolved issues.

collection.emptyMessage: No issue resolution evidence has been recorded.

questions.text: Record deferred issues and the authorization for deferral.

collection.emptyMessage: No issues have been deferred.

questions.text: Have all identified takeover observations been reviewed and either recorded as issues or explicitly closed as requiring no action?
Are there any unresolved critical issues that prevent safe progression to remediation planning?
Is the issue register sufficiently complete and controlled for remediation planning to begin?
Record the remediation actions proposed for identified takeover issues.
questions.helpText: Each action must reference the issue it addresses and define ownership, priority, approval requirements, and verification.

collection.emptyMessage: No remediation actions have been recorded.

fields.label: Action reference
fields.helpText: Use the assigned remediation reference, such as RA-001.

questions.text: Record dependencies and sequencing requirements between remediation actions.

collection.emptyMessage: No remediation dependencies have been recorded.

questions.text: Record approvals for remediation work.
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference the written approval, signed document, approved proposal, or other durable authorization.

collection.emptyMessage: No remediation approvals have been recorded.

questions.text: Have all open critical and high-severity issues been assigned a remediation action, formal deferral, or documented risk acceptance?
Is the remediation plan complete, prioritized, commercially clear, and ready for review?

choices.label: Yes, with clearly identified approvals still pending

questions.text: What is the final status of the takeover audit?
